run_comms_trace_replay: run the commsTraceReplayBench to replay collective communication traces from a JSON trace file with benchmarking
run_dry_run_trace_analysis: run a dry-run analysis of a comms trace file to get message count and size statistics without replaying
run_trace_replay_with_profiler: run the trace replay benchmark with profiler enabled to collect performance data across multiple replay iterations
extract_comms_info_from_trace: extract collective communication info from a basic trace JSON and convert it to commsArgs objects
write_comm_details_to_json: write replayed communication performance details for a given rank to a JSON file in the output folder
